title: Can you make models believe false facts in the prompt?
abstract: arXiv:2611.23938v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Making LLMs believe false facts is useful for alignment evaluations and for building model organisms. Previous work explored doing so with Synthetic Document Finetuning (SDF). But SDF requires fine-tuning one new model for each set of injected false beliefs. To enable larger scale SDF-powered alignment evaluations, we attempt to produce a single model that believes any fact placed in a  tag in the prompt. To do so, we explore doing prompt-conditioned SDF: fine-tuning a model on synthetic documents covering thousands of facts, with each document conditioned on a fact presented in the prompt. We evaluate how deeply the model believes the facts provided in the prompt using evaluations from prior work and a new Jacobian lens evaluation. We find that the belief depth on unseen facts scales roughly log-linearly with the number of training facts, making this a cheap, promising avenue for making models believe false facts, though preliminary exp

translated_title: 你能让模型相信提示词中的虚假事实吗？
translated_abstract: 让大语言模型相信虚假事实对于对齐评估和构建模型生物体非常有用。先前的工作探索了使用合成文档微调（SDF）来实现这一目标。但SDF需要为每组注入的虚假信念单独微调一个新模型。为了实现更大规模的基于SDF的对齐评估，我们尝试训练一个能够相信提示词中特定标签内放置的任何事实的单一模型。为此，我们探索了提示条件化的SDF：在涵盖数千个事实的合成文档上微调模型，每个文档都以提示中呈现的对应事实为条件。我们使用先前工作的评估方法以及一种新的Jacobian透镜评估方法，来评估模型对提示中提供的事实的信念深度。我们发现，模型对未见事实的信念深度大致随训练事实数量的增加呈对数线性增长，这使该方法成为让模型相信虚假事实的一种低成本且有前景的途径，尽管初步实验……
tldr: 本文提出提示条件化的合成文档微调方法，通过单一模型即可使模型相信提示中注入的任意虚假事实，且对未见事实的信念深度随训练事实数量大致呈对数线性增长。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes prompt-conditioned Synthetic Document Finetuning (SDF), enabling a single model to believe any false fact injected into the prompt, with belief depth on unseen facts scaling roughly log-linearly with the number of training facts.
